arm: form-preserving: voice corpus + self-distilled form anchor
anchor_source: base-model generations that PASSED verify_form.py, across three seeds
why_even_across_forms: matches the prompt distribution P0/P2 are scored on; weighting toward 七絕 would make it a 七絕 booster, and 七絕 is the scored form
what_it_does_not_do: this is NOT KL-to-base. It anchors by DATA, not by a loss term — cheaper and available in mlx-lm, but it constrains the behaviour only where the anchor examples reach.
